{"consolidated_memory":"## Corrupted Scaffold in cli/commands/init.py: Series of 8 Incidents (2026-03-10 to 2026-08-13)

**Common characteristics across all incidents:**
- Problem: corrupted scaffold in the init command (cli/commands/init.py, developer tooling side)
- Reproduction: init into a directory that already has a lockfile
- Signal: a generated tree missing one file
- Context: all occurred in the same corner of cli/commands/init.py; context carried over between fixes

**Individual incidents with distinct triggers, root causes, and fixes:**

### Incident 1: [2026-03-10] Deep Nesting (c027-e0)
- Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
- Fix: prefetched the relation in a single query (PR #1155, branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-1)
- Outcome: throughput rose 20 percent, to 204 requests per second

### Incident 2: [2026-05-31] High Key Volume (c027-e1)
- Trigger: tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- Root cause: a listener registered but never removed
- Fix: removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test (PR #3225, branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-2)
- Outcome: job finished in 23 minutes instead of 2 hours

### Incident 3: [2026-06-24] Cold Start (c027-e2)
- Trigger: first request after a cold start
- Root cause: an error swallowed by a bare except
- Fix: narrowed the handler and let the failure propagate (PR #4037, branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-3)
- Outcome: reclaimed 39 GB of blob storage

### Incident 4: [2026-07-15] Retry Timing (c027-e3)
- Trigger: after the client had already retried once
- Root cause: a naive datetime compared against an aware one
- Fix: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge (PR #4501, branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-4)
- Outcome: the backlog cleared 62 minutes after the deploy

### Incident 5: [2026-07-28] Request Race (c027-e4)
- Trigger: two requests raced on the same key
- Root cause: missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- Fix: normalised to NFC ahead of the digest (PR #6301, branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-5)
- Outcome: flaky test went from 64 failures per hundred runs to zero

### Incident 6: [2026-08-05] Rollout Bucket (c027-e5)
- Trigger: accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- Root cause: clock skew between the two hosts
- Fix: switched the deadline to a monotonic clock (PR #8105, branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-6)
- Outcome: cold start dropped 3 percent, to 363 ms

### Incident 7: [2026-08-06] Non-ASCII Records (c027-e6)
- Trigger: records carrying non-ASCII names
- Root cause: two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
- Fix: wrapped both writes in one transaction (PR #8436, branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-7)
- Outcome: error rate dropped from 2.7 percent to under 2 per ten thousand

### Incident 8: [2026-08-13] v1 SDK Clients (c027-e7)
- Trigger: clients still pinned to the v1 SDK
- Root cause: a race in lazy initialisation
- Fix: guarded the init with a double-checked lock (PR #8790, branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-8)
- Outcome: nightly rollup matched the source counts for 12 days running"}
